description: This PHP source file manages default email template configurations and password settings within the SuiteCRM project, including creating default email templates for new account emails, password reset emails, and two-factor authentication emails, as well as setting default password policies.

classes.name: EmailTemp
classes.description: A bean representing an email template, with properties such as name, description, subject, type, body, and flags like deleted, published, text_only, and an ID for saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the email template bean to the database, returning the ID.
